info.title: Adeli API
info.summary: One REST API to publish, comment, message, and read analytics on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X, and Bluesky.
info.description: Adeli maintains the developer app on every network, completes each platform's review, and manages OAuth and token refresh, so you hold one API key. Your first 3 connected accounts are free. Guides and examples: https://www.tryadeli.com/docs

tags.name: API key

tags.name: Profiles

post.description: Publish to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X, or Bluesky. Instagram requests using only staged upload references are durably accepted with 202 and a status URL; legacy base64 or URL inputs remain synchronous during the compatibility window. Send `multipart/form-data` only for TikTok uploads on this shared endpoint.
